test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six employees (A, B, C, D, E, F) are sitting at a round table with eight chairs. Two of them are not sitting exactly opposite each other. One has nobody sitting adjacent to him. C is sitting third right of D. E is sitting on the third right to F. B is sitting opposite A. D is sitting opposite E. C is sitting between A and E.

What is the position of F with respect to C?
solution: Six employees: A, B, C, D, E and F. 1) E is sitting on the third right to F. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a66007667a43506569e0dfa93013c2e8e9e1484a7cc636be198582b34a836ca3.png] 2) D is sitting opposite E.
